DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気になることがあったら、いつでも何でも何度でも！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: わざわざ調べに行かずとも、ぜひこのコトリに聞いてください！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: コトリの専門は自然科学全般だっけ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何でも……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと、そうですね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一応私の専攻は主に自然科学全般ですが、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 基本的には、何でも大丈夫です！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私に説明出来ることでしたら、何でもどんとこいです！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生？どこへ行かれたんですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まさか、逃げたわけではありませんよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気になることがあればいつでも言ってくださいね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 知的好奇心の傍には、いつもコトリがいますから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございました、先生！感動しました！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まさかここまでの速さで理解してくれるなんて！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……えっと、先生、もしよろしければ時々でも良いので、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……よろしくお願いしますね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今お時間ありますでしょうか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、大したことではないのですが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いえ、個人的には大事なことなのですが……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: と、とにかくですね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと、質問と言いますか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お聞きしたいことがありまして……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫だよ、どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 説明じゃなくて質問？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございます！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一も二も無く、さすが先生です！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: アウトプットのためにはインプットが必要ですから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それに、

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 他でもない、先生にこそ聞きたいことなんです！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、ではあの場所で

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 待ってますね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……えっと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、あらためまして、先ほどはありがとうございました！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: やっぱり先生に尋ねてみて正解でした！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私の方からきちんと説明してあげられそうです！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それは良かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 結局どういうことだったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えへへ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい、本当に良かったです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとうございました、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、それは……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 秘密、です……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: えっと、それでは、また

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おはようございます！何か気になることがありましたら、いつでも仰ってください！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 疑問や質問があれば、いつでもぜひこのコトリに！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 念のためなのですが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その、ミュート設定されてたり、しないですよね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時々、そういうこともあるので……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんなことはないよ、それにちょうど聞きたいことがあって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ナイスタイミング、質問がありますコトリさん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ほ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当ですか！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お任せください、何でもお答えしますよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それではコトリ！今すぐそちらへ参りますので！>_<

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すみま

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すみませんでした、先生……その、あまりにも予想外の質問だったと言いますか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当にその、不意を突かれたと言いますか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: すみません、前にもこんなことがあった気がしますね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今度よろしければ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いえ、私の準備ができてないので、すぐではないのですが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その時でも、良いですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちゃんと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちゃんと答えを、出しますので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふぅ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 危ないところでした！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: コトリ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、大したことではありません！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 実はメガネが壊れてしまい、修理をお願いしていたんです

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一日ぐらいはなくても大丈夫だろうと思っていたのですが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私の視力では無理でしたね！あはは！！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 멀리 갈 필요 없습니다, 이 코토리에게 물어보세요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇네요. 비록 과학 쪽이 제 전공이긴 하지만

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 설마 이해해 주는 사람이 있을 줄은 몰랐는데!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그분께는 제가 잘 설명해 드릴 수 있을 거 같아요! 걱정하지 마세요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭔가 늘 똑같은 메시지를 보내는 느낌이 드는데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 해서 여쭤보는 거지만, 스팸 등록이라던가……. 그런 걸 당한 건 아니겠죠, 저?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아냐. 마침 물어보고 싶은 게 있었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 죄송합니다, 선생님……. 너무 생각지도 못 한 질문이라 저도 모르게 그만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 정말로, 그런 종류의 질문이실 거라곤 상상도 못 했어서…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 전에도 이런 일이 있었던 것 같은데…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음에 혹시 괜찮으시면, 언젠가 저도 준비가 됐을 때!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그저 안경이 조금 부러져서, 수리를 맡겼었거든요.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Just ask me anything at all! Anytime, anywhere!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No need to go anywhere else! Just ask Kotori!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: but you can ask me anything!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you have any questions, just ask me anytime!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can answer all your questions!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I never imagined someone would understand!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So you can expect me to ask you things...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean, it is pretty important!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have something to ask you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A question rather than an explanation?

DialogEN.Text: I knew I could count on you!

DialogEN.Text: I know I'm smart, but I could have questions too!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm not just asking anybody. I'm asking you!

DialogEN.Text: Calling you is always a good idea!

DialogEN.Text: I think I can provide a pretty good explanation! Don't worry!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you have any questions, just ask me anytime!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can answer all your questions!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It feels like I've sent the same message a thousand times...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm just wondering but you didn't put me on...a spam filter did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Nice timing! I have a question!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yay, I'm happy to hear that! I'll answer anything!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Kotori, on the move right now!! >_<!!

DialogEN.Text: Sorry, Sensei... I didn't expect your question at all, so I...

DialogEN.Text: I really didn't expect you to ask that...

DialogEN.Text: Speaking of which, I think something like this has happened before.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Next time if it's okay, please ask me when I'm prepared!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I promise I'll be able to answer it.

DialogEN.Text: My glasses were slightly broken, so I had them repaired.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought I could last a day without them,

DialogEN.Text: but it turns out it's pretty difficult to do that when you have bad eyesight! Haha!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:

DialogTH.Text:
ใช่แล้วค่ะ ถึงวิทยาศาสตร์จะเป็นเรื่องที่

DialogTH.Text: แล้วก็...

DialogTH.Text:

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หึหึหึ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้น ฉันจะรอคุณครูนะคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เมื่อกี้ขอบคุณมากนะคะ!

DialogTH.Text: โชคดีจังเลยน้า~

DialogTH.Text: นั่นสิคะ โชคดีจริงๆ เลยค่ะ

DialogTH.Text: คะ...

DialogTH.Text: นั่นละค่ะ...

DialogTH.Text:

DialogTH.Text: เอ่อ...

DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเป็นตอนนั้น...

DialogTW.Text: 如果有任何問題，無論什麼時候，不管幾次都可以！

DialogTW.Text: 讓亞都梨陪你解決各種疑惑！

DialogTW.Text: 那個，沒有被設定為靜音吧……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒有那種事，而且正好有想問的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 來得正好，我有疑問，亞都梨老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 交給我吧，什麼都能回答！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，亞都梨！現在馬上過去！>_<

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 對不起，老師……那個，該說問題太出乎預料嗎……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我實在沒想過會是那種問題……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前好像也發生過類似的事……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果可以的話，等我做好準備之後

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是眼鏡出了點問題，所以送去修理了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 本來想說一天不戴眼鏡應該沒問題

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 結果我的視力根本不行！啊哈哈！！
